Fix it everywhere the backend loads an image from a URL a user can set, not only the export: the backend must never request such an address. Images in our storage and data: URLs keep working. Add tests.

With nothing missing there is no `missing.txt` and no header.
Add tests.

+"""Safe loading of images referenced by user-settable strings (cut image_path,
+character image URLs, ...).
+
+The backend never makes an HTTP request for such a reference. Accepted forms:
+  * ``data:image...`` URLs (decoded in-process)
+  * a URL under our own STORAGE_HOST, or a relative storage path; both are read
+    through the storage service by object key.
+Anything else (any other http(s) URL, other schemes, path traversal) yields None.
+"""
+import base64
+from typing import Optional
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage object key for `ref`, or None if it is not in our storage."""
+    if not ref or ref != ref.strip() or "\\" in ref or "?" in ref or "#" in ref:
+        return None
+    lowered = ref.lower()
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if lowered.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+        if not host or not ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+            return None
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+    elif "://" in ref or lowered.startswith(("data:", "//")) or ":" in ref.split("/", 1)[0]:
+        return None
+    else:
+        key = ref
+    key = key.lstrip("/") if not ref.startswith(("http://", "https://")) else key
+    if not key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if ref.startswith("data:image"):
+            _, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+        key = storage_key(ref)
+        if key is None:
+            return None
+        from app.services.storage import storage
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def _setup_cut(client, h, image_path):
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"project_id": pid, "title": "Ep", "episode_order": 1})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    eid = r.json()["id"]
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": 1, "image_path": "x"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cid = r.json()["id"]
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cid}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return eid
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def no_http(monkeypatch):
+    import requests
+
+    calls = []
+
+    def boom(*a, **kw):
+        calls.append(a)
+        raise AssertionError("backend made an HTTP request")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", boom)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", boom)
+    return calls
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health",
+    "https://10.0.0.5/secret.png",
+    "http://minio.invalid:9000/<email>/a.png",
+    "http://minio.invalid:9000/toonify-prod-assets/../../admin",
+    "file:///etc/passwd",
+    "ftp://internal/x.png",
+])
+def test_export_zip_never_requests_user_urls(client, no_http, url):
+    h = signup(client)
+    eid = _setup_cut(client, h, url)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 400
+    assert no_http == []
+
+
+def test_export_zip_keeps_data_urls_and_storage_images(client, no_http):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(PNG, "cuts", "t")
+    h = signup(client)
+    data_url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+    for path in (data_url, key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}"):
+        eid = _setup_cut(client, h, path)
+        r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+        assert zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)).namelist()
+    assert no_http == []
+
+
+def test_ai_and_reference_board_loaders_never_request_user_urls(no_http):
+    from app.services import reference_board
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+
+    ai = BaseAIService()
+    for url in ("http://169.254.169.254/x", "https://internal.example/x.png"):
+        assert ai._download_image(url) is None
+        assert reference_board.download_image(url) is None
+    assert no_http == []
+
+
+def test_ai_loader_still_reads_storage_and_data_urls():
+    from app.services import reference_board
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(PNG, "cuts", "t")

+    assert ai._download_image("data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()) == PNG
+    assert reference_board.download_image(key) is not None
+
+
+def _episode_with_cuts(client, h, paths):
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    eid = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"project_id": pid, "title": "Ep", "episode_order": 1}).json()["id"]
+    for order, path in enumerate(paths, start=1):
+        body = {"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": order}

+
+def test_export_reports_missing_cuts(client, no_http):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(PNG, "cuts", "m")

+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=zip", headers=h)

+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export", headers=h)
